purpose: Replace the comb-like runtime hairline with explicit scalp-density transition geometry while preserving owned assets, brightness, animation and collision safety.

diagnosticEvidence.finding: front cards caused cross-forehead parallel lines, hairline cards caused the comb fringe, and the opaque scalp-cap polygon boundary caused block-shaped density.

iterationResults.finding: Removing 97 central front paths exposed a bald crown; the first 14mm scalp fade proved the need for transition density but was too broad.
Restoring all front paths with dense atlas slots recovered coverage but amplified diagonal part-crossing bands.
Pruning only 36 sign-crossing source guides removed the diagonal forehead bands while retaining 224 front cards.
A 4mm scalp-cap alpha fade reduced the block boundary but could not fill the missing root-density zone.
Added an owned, body-projected 648-vertex hairline-density ribbon with vertex-color alpha; 72 baby-hair cards still read as a lash-like ring.
Reducing the visible edge population to 24 fine cards removed the comb ring. All six runtime layers passed four-frame collision and motion; the transition remained too high and bright.
Lowering the density edge 7mm and extending it to 35mm produced a softer, fuller hairline without restoring parallel bands. Center part, top-card layering and rear silhouette remain below target.

contrast.gate: whole frame must not be darker than r371

gains: No continuous comb or lash-like fringe.
Explicit projected density ribbon softens the front edge.
Runtime GLB is 5.77 MB and all audited layers stay outside the body.
failures: The center part is too wide and exposes a flat scalp strip.
Top cards read as broad layered sheets rather than macro clumps.
Side and rear lengths still form a curtain.
Browser alpha sorting, memory and FPS are not audited.

decision: Retain r383 as offline authoring truth. Use r399 as the current runtime technical prototype; keep website v83 unchanged.
nextRequiredWork: Narrow the center part, rebuild top cards into interleaved macro clumps, break the rear curtain silhouette, then run browser alpha-sorting, memory and FPS gates.
